scope: Official train only; no labels loaded, no model fitting, no external data or documentation fetched; purpose-selected examples, not a coverage estimate.
selection: Eight previously located rows were reread from current official train. Selection was purposive from earlier diagnostics, not label-blind random sampling; this pass did not load label_binary.
normalization_principle: Format inference is from visible syntax, not product metadata or labels. Keep exact raw spans and unsupported body. Do not infer original words from redaction tokens.
span_indexing: Python Unicode code-point indices into the exact raw message, start inclusive/end exclusive; not byte offsets.
implementation_boundary: Suggestions only. No regex here is a production normalizer. Full-family coverage, temporal availability and meaning of unknown fields remain unverified.
unimplemented_required_checks: Field-aware identity/date perturbations preserve the retained action representation.
Changes to event code/result/negation/port role/literal boolean change the appropriate retained evidence.
Metadata and raw-body entity mismatches are counted rather than silently reconciled.
Broken marker spans do not concatenate remaining digits into valid ports, timestamps, IDs or codes.
Unknown formats preserve readable body and expose unsupported status only as diagnostics, not a benign rule.
Post-hoc/upstream and mixed descriptive spans are not interpreted without reliable boundaries and availability.
